MALIDUP.name: MALIDUP
MALIDUP.description: Database of true homologs with low sequence identity, typically resulting from domain duplication events with the same structural fold.
MALIDUP.purpose: Evaluate recall on challenging true homolog detection

MALISAM.name: MALISAM
MALISAM.description: Database of non-homologous structural analogs that share similar structures but different evolutionary origins.
MALISAM.purpose: Evaluate false positive rate on structural mimics
MALISAM.evaluation_goal: Low false alignment (↑ higher is better, but should stay low)

SABmark.name: SABmark
SABmark.description: Benchmark dataset for evaluating sequence alignment methods on remote homologs, grouped by SCOP superfamilies with structural alignments as ground truth.
SABmark.purpose: Evaluate alignment accuracy on remote homologs
SABmark.evaluation_goal: High recall and accuracy (↑ higher is better)

f1.name: F1 Score
f1.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall

precision.name: Precision
precision.description: Fraction of predicted alignments that are correct

recall.name: Recall
recall.description: Fraction of true alignments that are recovered

Traditional.description: Classical sequence alignment methods using dynamic programming or profile-based approaches

PLM-based.description: Methods using Protein Language Model embeddings for alignment

OTalign.description: Optimal Transport-based alignment methods developed in this work
